articles.summary: Households are adding solar panels, batteries, electric vehicles (EVs) and heat pumps that can help balance electricity supply and demand. Unlocking their flexibility at scale means connecting these devices to the energy market in ways that let households participate without managing every detail.
articles.title: From household flexibility to an open European energy market

articles.summary: CGI Federal announced the launch of the Super Intelligence (SI) Workforce Development Coalition, an initiative designed to prepare college graduates for an emerging hybrid workforce environment in which humans and SI work shoulder-to-virtual-shoulder.
articles.title: CGI Federal launches SI Workforce Development Coalition, accelerating next-generation human-SI workforce readiness with AWS
